(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define colors (grid-colors g 0))
             (define objs (objects g 0))
             (define (obj-size obj)
               (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                      (hh (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
                      (ww (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))))
                 (max hh ww)))
             (define (best-object color)
               (pick-max (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) objs)
                         obj-size))
             (define layers
               (sort (map best-object colors)
                     (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
             (define n (obj-size (first layers)))
             (define ring-colors (reverse (map obj-color layers)))
             (define (paint-layer out obj color)
               (let* ((s (obj-size obj))
                      (off (quotient (- n s) 2)))
                 (for*/fold ((acc out))
                            ((r (in-range off (+ off s))) (c (in-range off (+ off s))))
                            (if (or
                                  (= r off)
                                  (= r (- (+ off s) 1))
                                  (= c off)
                                  (= c (- (+ off s) 1)))
                                (set-cell acc r c color)
                                acc))))
             (for/fold ((out (empty-grid n n 0)))
                       ((obj layers) (color ring-colors))
               (paint-layer out obj color))))))
